notes.content:
[list]

notes.title: I Just Want to be Single!! launches in TWO DAYS!!
notes.content:
After the last update I was sure the game was going to launch in November but due to some internal issues with Steam and some last minute backend things to do it got delayed. I've been quiet about it since then because I didn't want to make another announcement before confirming anything with the utmost certainty, which might have caused some confusion.

Things got a bit delayed - however, I'm happy to announce that the game will be officially launching in 2 days, on February the 24th (Monday).

I will be working on the game as it goes live for hotfixes and bugs that will appear on launch, and I'll be continuing to update you guys on progress as we go into the first season of - I Just Want to be Single!!

We've prepared you an FAQ that will help you prepare for the game's launch

[list]
[*] It will work on PC and Mac and Linux
[*] It will be priced at $20 (with a 10% discount on launch and adjusted for your region)
[*] The game price will be raised when Season Two is released (You automatically get Season Two free and all future updates if you buy the game now)
[*] The current game has the extended prologue, as well as introductory chapters for each character
[*] The game will continue to be updated as time goes on, progress updates will be brought to you via updates here, our Discord and Steam announcements
[/list]

If you have any questions or issues please let me know in either the comments, or our [url=https://discord.gg/euNm2ur5ZM]Discord server.[/url]

notes.title: Demo update 1.2
notes.content:
Hey hey!
Today I'm adding a couple of minor changes to the demo which are mostly quality of life improvements.

[list]
[*] Clearer instructions on how the Charging/Intensity mechanic works
[*] Better phrasing on some question prompts (The sports club one)
[*] A special scene for when you input a secret input in an area. (Yeah, I know, super vague but you should find out yourself what I'm talking about!)
[/list]

That's it for now! I probably won't update the demo again, unless it's for minor optimizations which won't be documented but I'll still be posting updates on progress of the full game!

Also make sure you check out our currently on-going Kickstarter and support us! You can [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/studiotsundere/i-just-want-to-be-single/]find it here[/url]. Thanks for reading!

notes.title: Demo Update 1.1
notes.content:
Updated the demo to version 1.1

In this update, I:

[list]
[*] Optimized performance in parts where it lagged a bit before, so you should be getting a smoother experience.
[*] Sections where you need to remember details for a star are more forgiving now (especially the sports one)
[*] Fixed a few typos.
[*] Dynamic capitalization for lazy people who don't use proper punctuation for their inputs kek (basically the game will correctly capitalize your words for you)
[*] Disabled Renpy's default accessibility menu which sometimes gets accidentally shown by pressing the 'A' key.
[*] The infamous "ascended" bug where sprites become glowy white should occur less now.
[/list]


[h2]If you have a bug to report, feel free to drop by our discord server! (we have dank memes)[/h2]
